updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.9.2 
 - Move VKB BRA/BE display ribbon down on EFB Map both Portrait and Landscape orientations. 
 - VKB Tab Rail handling in Landscape orientaton on small devices now scales correctly. 
 - VKB FLT PLN Tab NAVLOG column scaling now has minimum width for readability and if required adds horizontal table psition bar at bottom of NALOG (iPad mini). 
 - DIR TO/DEL STP function now works similar to Alt/SPD popup edits, single click STP number and then select required mode to arm, click desired SIR TO STP or STP to delete. 
 - Fix VKB NAVLOG Metric units handling.
